Location: Lincoln, Massachusetts
Type: Full-Time or Part-Time
Salary: $150,000-$280,000+ based on experience, credentials, and schedule
​
Why Ally Veterinary Specialty Center?
At Ally Veterinary Specialty Center, we believe veterinary medicine could be different, so we made it. We're a woman-owned and led independent boutique center dedicated to providing exceptional, personalized care to pets and their owners. As an established specialty practice expanding into new disciplines, we're looking for a passionate oncologist ready to design their ideal practice.
This is a rare opportunity: You won't just join a practice; you'll shape one from the ground up alongside an innovative leadership team and collaborative specialists in dermatology, ophthalmology, internal medicine, cardiology, neurology, and behavior.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a collaborative and entrepreneurial Veterinary Oncologist to launch and lead oncology services at Ally. Whether you're ready to begin in our current space or looking to transition over the coming months, you'll have a dedicated exam room and treatment space, with direct input on building your oncology program and diagnostic capabilities as we grow.
This role is ideal for someone who:
Wants autonomy in designing their diagnostic approach, treatment protocols, and patient experience
Values a predictable schedule focused on oncology without emergency demands or hospitalization
Thrives in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment where you consult with other specialists
Seeks meaningful input on diagnostic equipment, treatment options, and team structure
Is passionate about delivering comprehensive oncology diagnostics and compassionate care
Is excited about building something from the ground up while contributing to the vision for our expanded future.
​
​
What Makes This Different
​
Your Own Oncology Practice
Unlike corporate hospitals or high-volume clinics, you'll design your oncology practice from the foundation up. You'll have direct input on:
Diagnostic equipment for oncology imaging and laboratory testing
Treatment space configuration tailored to your clinical approach and protocols
Chemotherapy and treatment management protocols aligned with your philosophy
Team composition and collaboration with internal medicine and other specialists
The Collaborative Advantage
Work alongside board-certified specialists in dermatology, ophthalmology, internal medicine, cardiology, neurology, and behavior. Consult on complex cases involving oncologic disease and systemic conditions, collaborate on comprehensive treatment plans, and build a referral network in a supportive, collegial environment.
Diagnostic and Treatment-Based Practice Model
As an out-patient specialty facility focused on oncology diagnostics and medical management, you'll enjoy:
Deep, thorough diagnostic consultations without rushed time constraints
Focus on compassionate oncology care and medical protocols rather than emergency treatment
Flexible scheduling tailored to diagnostic and consultation-based work
Strong relationships with referring veterinarians and committed pet owners
The Freedom to Build
Partner with an established, successful practice that understands specialty medicine challenges. Have a voice in practice decisions, equipment investments, and growth direction while enjoying the support structure you need to thrive.
​
Facility Highlights
State-of-the-art facility currently being built, designed with input from all specialist team members
Dedicated oncology exam and treatment space with latest diagnostic technology
Advanced diagnostic imaging and oncology treatment capabilities
Collaborative environment with dermatology, ophthalmology, internal medicine, cardiology, neurology, and behavior specialists
​
What We Offer
​
Professional Autonomy and Growth
Direct input on equipment selection, diagnostic protocols, and workspace design
Flexibility to customize your schedule (full-time, part-time, or flexible arrangements)
Opportunities for professional development, continuing education, and conference attendance with financial support
Access to state-of-the-art diagnostic imaging and oncology treatment technology
​
Comprehensive Support
Dedicated administrative and clinical support team
Practice guidance and operational structure from an experienced business owner
Collaborative relationships with board-certified specialists in complementary fields
No emergency or hospitalization responsibilities
​
Career Development
Input on practice growth and service expansion opportunities
Mentorship and professional development support
Direct influence on how oncology services evolve and expand
​
Comprehensive Benefits Package
​
Compensation and Financial
Competitive salary: $150,000-$280,000+ based on credentials, experience, and schedule
Sign-on bonus (available)
Relocation assistance
Production incentives (structured to reward quality diagnostics and patient care)
​
Health and Wellness
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
401(k) with company matching contributions
Mental health and wellness resources
Generous paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays, and parental leave)
​
Professional Support and Development
Continuing education stipend ($3,000+ annually)
License renewal and professional membership reimbursement
Conference attendance support
Paid professional liability insurance
Access to professional oncology networks and resources
​
Work-Life Balance
No required nights, weekends, or holidays
Flexible scheduling tailored to your life
Pet discounts for team members
Modern facilities designed with wellness in mind
​
Ideal Candidate
You are a board-certified veterinary oncologist (ACVIM - Oncology) or residency-trained oncologist with strong expertise in oncology diagnostics and medical management who:
Holds a DVM or equivalent degree with current state licensure
Brings expertise in oncology diagnostics, chemotherapy, and medical management
Values collaboration, client communication, and evidence-based oncology
Is entrepreneurial and excited about building something new
Wants autonomy, flexibility, and a voice in practice direction
Prioritizes compassionate patient care and quality diagnostics
Thrives in a collegial, multi-disciplinary team environment
​
How to Apply
Interested in discussing this unique opportunity? We'd love to hear from you.
Email:
admin@allyvetspecialist.com
Subject Line: Veterinary Oncology Application – [Your Name]
Include:
Your CV or resume
Cover letter (tell us why this opportunity excites you)
Contact information
Learn more about us:
www.allyvetspecialist.com
​
A Final Word
You didn't spend years training in oncology to work in a setting that doesn't value compassionate, quality patient care. At Ally, you'll practice oncology the way you envisioned it—with time for thorough diagnostics and meaningful consultations, supported by a team that gets it, with the autonomy to make it your own, and the opportunity to build an oncology practice that truly makes a difference in pets' lives.
Interested in joining us? Let's explore how this unique opportunity could be the right next step in your career.
​
